# HeadTTS language modules

Unmodified language modules from https://github.com/met4citizen/HeadTTS
revision c08f4ca8b3253b3e908e501486a1e068e606be5c (MIT; see LICENSE).
Only the local English phonemizer is used; no server or speech transport code.
The separately installed CMU-derived dictionary retains its own notice/header.
Application normalization and source ownership checks live outside these files.
